280.$description: A duration, for the slideshow's colour cards: their title and arrow fade out in 280ms, twice as fast as the card's own 560ms morph. Specific to that animation.

470.$description: A wait, for the bento's pagination controls in the homepage opening: they come in 470ms after the pictures start opening, when the last column (70ms late, 400ms long) has finished. Specific to that animation; not a duration for a move.

630.$description: A wait, for the page's opening: the second colour card starts 70ms after the first. Specific to that animation; not a duration for a move.

700.$description: A wait, for the page's opening: the third colour card starts 70ms after the second. Specific to that animation; not a duration for a move.

900.$description: A wait, for the page's opening: the logomark's rings start to unlock when the title is done (900ms). Specific to that animation; not a duration for a move.

940.$description: A wait, for the page's opening: the first bento card starts 40ms after the title is done (the title finishes at 900ms). Specific to that animation; not a duration for a move.

1010.$description: A wait, for the page's opening: the second bento card, 70ms after the first. Specific to that animation; not a duration for a move.

1080.$description: A wait, for the page's opening: the bento's pictures open this long after its cards are in (1060ms), 70ms after the sidebar (2140ms). Specific to that animation; not a duration for a move.

1140.$description: A wait, for the page's opening (page version v13): the page starts going to white 500ms after the title has finished (its last line has faded in at 640ms); the fade takes 560ms. Specific to that animation; not a duration for a move.

1190.$description: A wait, for the page's opening: the second colour card starts 70ms after the first (1120ms + 70ms). Specific to that animation; not a duration for a move.

1260.$description: A wait, for the page's opening: the third colour card starts 70ms after the second (1190ms + 70ms). Specific to that animation; not a duration for a move.

1600.$description: A wait, for a page that opens in a sequence (the navigation and the header come in at 1600ms). Not a duration for a move: nothing plays an easing this long.

1640.$description: A wait, for the white opening (page version v12): the pattern starts settling and the header and the nav come in together, 1 second after the title's last line has faded in (640ms). Specific to that animation; not a duration for a move.

1780.$description: A wait, for the white opening (page version v12): the bento's second card comes in 70ms after the first (1710ms + 70ms). Specific to that animation; not a duration for a move.
